d: Long, jet black braided hair flows from a masked head, contrasting with sharp, glowing crimson eyes visible through a white and gold metallic face mask. This mature, muscular figure has a powerful, athletic build with greyish-blue skin. The outfit consists of a white and gold chest piece with a glowing blue core, dark charcoal leggings, and a flowing dark grey tattered cloak with a purple underside, complemented by white armored boots. Signature details include a large spiked mace held aloft, metallic white armor plating on the shoulders and arms, and jagged grey crystalline structures erupting around the feet. BODY COLOR: greyish-blue
